description: NIST's FTC-06 (real/nist-ftc-06, its file read in place) cut by a box 0.02 across at the oracle's centroid: every face of both operands is split before any is classified, and the part's f0, a plane whose outer loop runs two arcs of one r 22.225 circle end to end among r 3.175 blends, which no section crosses, has ten cusps where a blend leaves a line tangent to it: each is a turn of +π round its spike, and the loop turns once. The part itself reads checker-green at Full. Shrunk from the battery of real/nist-ftc-06, whose every cut and drill met it; the file is not shrunk further (ADR-0026 §4)

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE heals FTC-06 as it reads it (occt_heals, ADR-0026 §3), 227/310/144/223 in the file become 250/373/144/183, so its counts are not the file's; Arris's are its own reading of the file, 246/369/144/183 (real/nist-ftc-06), and the speck's cavity, 8/12/6/6 in a second shell
